_comment: Budgets are off until you set a limit (/tokentab:budget). session_limit_usd depends on prices.json being right. session_limit_tokens is exact. Set either or both; whichever is closest to its limit governs. null disables that one.
_context_comment: Context size of the last call. Every call re-reads it all, so this is what each call costs. Warns once per threshold; resets after a compact.
_cold_comment: Blocks the first prompt after the prompt cache has expired, before anything is sent, when re-writing the context would be expensive. Sending again within confirm_seconds goes ahead. fresh_session_tokens estimates what a new session writes to start: the ~45k baseline plus ~30k re-read.
_job_comment: Job budget: start a prompt with "$2:", "beer:" or "200k:". Runs until the next one; "nobudget:" clears it. ask (off by default): estimate on a session's first prompt when no budget is set, and ask only when the estimate is over ask_over_usd. ask_mid_request (off by default): one notice when a request passes ask_over_usd with no job budget. hard_stop true blocks at 100% and pauses every agent at the mid-request check-in; false (the default) only tells you.
_new_session_comment: Sends Claude the context size, cost per call and break-even for a new session with every prompt, so it can suggest one when the new prompt does not need this conversation.
_helpers_comment: Helper (subagent) tool calls get hard stops but not warnings, cannot start other agents unless helpers_may_delegate, and a budget check-in pauses them until the user answers.
